features.title: Feel supported from head to hip
features.text: Our sofa’s high backrest is designed to fully support your upper body—gently cradling your shoulders and back so you can sit upright with ease, or lean in and relax, without ever feeling unsupported.

features.title: Comfort where your back needs it most
features.text: Enhanced lumbar support helps maintain your natural posture, easing tension in your lower back. It's the kind of quiet support you don’t notice at first—but miss the moment it’s gone.

features.title: Armrests that understand your posture
features.text: The broad, rounded arms are ergonomically designed to follow the shape of your seated body. Whether you’re relaxing, scrolling, or catching up with loved ones, they’re always in the right place.

features.title: A backrest that responds to you
features.text: Filled with soft recron fibre, the backrest offers a light, buoyant feel that adapts to your shape. It gently hugs you without sinking too far—helping you feel weightless, not stuck.

features.title: Strong legs that lift you up
features.text: Our sturdy PVC legs not only provide dependable support, they also lift the sofa just enough to keep things easy to clean. Elevated, stable, and thoughtfully designed for real life.

features.title: Upholstery that’s easy to live with
features.text: Our sofa is upholstered in high-quality synthetic leather that balances beauty with practicality. It resists spills, scuffs, and daily wear—so you can enjoy a sophisticated look without worrying about constant upkeep. Comfort shouldn’t come with conditions, and neither should style.
